w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Leo. Gavel, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Focus Group is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (Spool, Loud-Eyes, Chorus Line, Buffering, Big Ugly) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Chorus Line mauled Leo (-21 health) over 15 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Terms of Service.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE CALLBACK! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Buffering: Stand still. It aims where you will be. Give it nothing to predict and it whiffs. (Sanne lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Ad Break: Look away when the break runs. Every fourth round it runs the break — repositions, knits itself back together, and WATCHES you watch. Look away. The ad’s power is that you watch; unwatched, the break is just dead air and the healing never lands. (Zoe lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 💥 tiger's Rerun finds you — no dodging it.
firstContext: The tiger's head swings toward Paisley. You're on the list now — it doesn't forget.
Too close. The tiger's attention SNAPS to Zoe — proximity overrules patience.
💥 tiger's Rerun finds you — no dodging it.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Lizelle showed Sam the Elderberry — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.

🌙 Raid — Stonebridge came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~800 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +2394 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (22/15/9), with 7 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 9 · Forage 41 → 24 · capped · Craft 10 · Talk 19 · Explore 50 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Diana Osei ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ghostLines.line: 🚶 A man, maybe 30s is back with Feng.

ghostHits.line: 🚶 A man, maybe 30s is back with Feng.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Diana returns from the wilds hurt (health 4/100) — the trip cut short.
🧭 Wanjiru returns from the wilds hurt (health 4/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,019 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.

✨ CAPSTONE: Phase Shawl. Sometimes your shoulder isn't where the spear lands. The shawl knows. Don't ask how. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
